answer: Paired-receipt bond: each identity locks 70 credits, filing one job as two receipts, one serial. Oasis ledger posts the first; a relay delivers the sealed twin, binding both to one key. Auditors pair by serial with a nebula seal: garden copy must match ledger copy or the bond burns; rented twins expose the lender. First pair 50, k-th 50+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,547,500 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 50 once and keep the bond.
